fields.appearance: 11th–12th century (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna: 11th century AD; the record: c. 1170)
fields.disappearance: Pauṣa kṛṣṇa ṣaṣṭhī (Gauḍīya calendar); the Jayadeva-melā at Kenduli on Pauṣa-saṅkrānti (1 Māgha)
fields.place: Born at Kendubilva (Kenduli), Birbhum, on the Ajaya; Navadvīpa (court of Lakṣmaṇa Sena), Campahāṭī; Purī; Vṛndāvana (Keśī-ghāṭa); Kenduli at the end (some say Purī)
fields.notes:
The poet of the Gīta-govinda, son of Bhojadeva and Vāmā Devī of Kendubilva, court paṇḍita of Lakṣmaṇa Sena (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna); Mahāprabhu relished his songs (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Madhya 2). Married Padmāvatī by Jagannātha's order; Kṛṣṇa Himself wrote «dehi pada-pallavam udāram» in his book. His Rādhā-Mādhava are now at Ghāṭī near Jaipur. The record «Jayadeva Gosvāmī» #597 was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

Dates/place from B. V. Tīrtha, “Sri Chaitanya: His Associates”.

fields.name: Guṇarāja Khān
fields.works: Śrī Kṛṣṇa-vijaya (1395–1402 Śaka, 1473–1480; the record holds Kuśakratha dāsa's translation)
fields.notes: Mālādhara Vasu of Kulīnagrāma, son of Bhagīratha Vasu and Indumatī, thirteenth from Daśaratha Vasu; «Khān» was a title from a king of Gauḍa (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Mahāprabhu: «nanda-nandana kṛṣṇa mora prāṇa-nātha — by this sentence I am sold into the hands of his descendants» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Madhya 15.99-100). Of his line: Satyarāja Khān and Rāmānanda Vasu.
